memberdef.name: BatesEngine

briefdescription.para: Bates model engines based on Fourier transform.

detaileddescription.para: this classes price european options under the following processes 1. Jump-Diffusion with Stochastic Volatility

para.formula: \[ \begin{array}{rcl} dS(t, S) &=& (r-d-\lambda m) S dt +\sqrt{v} S dW_1 + (e^J - 1) S dN \\ dv(t, S) &=& \kappa (\theta - v) dt + \sigma \sqrt{v} dW_2 \\ dW_1 dW_2 &=& \rho dt \end{array} \]
para.verbatim:
N is a Poisson process with the intensity \form#29@_fakenl. When a jump occurs the magnitude J has the probability density function \form#323.
1.1 Log-Normal Jump Diffusion: BatesEngine
Logarithm of the jump size J is normally distributed

1.2 Double-Exponential Jump Diffusion: BatesDoubleExpEngine
The jump size has an asymmetric double exponential distribution
2. Stochastic Volatility with Jump Diffusion and Deterministic Jump Intensity

para.formula: \[ \begin{array}{rcl} dS(t, S) &=& (r-d-\lambda m) S dt +\sqrt{v} S dW_1 + (e^J - 1) S dN \\ dv(t, S) &=& \kappa (\theta - v) dt + \sigma \sqrt{v} dW_2 \\ d\lambda(t) &=& \kappa_\lambda(\theta_\lambda-\lambda) dt \\ dW_1 dW_2 &=& \rho dt \end{array} \]
para.verbatim:
2.1 Log-Normal Jump Diffusion with Deterministic Jump Intensity BatesDetJumpEngine
2.2 Double-Exponential Jump Diffusion with Deterministic Jump Intensity BatesDoubleExpDetJumpEngine
References:
D. Bates, Jumps and stochastic volatility: exchange rate processes implicit in Deutsche mark options, Review of Financial Sudies 9, 69-107.
A. Sepp, Pricing European-Style Options under Jump Diffusion Processes with Stochastic Volatility: Applications of Fourier Transform (<http://math.ut.ee/~spartak/papers/stochjumpvols.pdf>)

xrefdescription.para: the correctness of the returned value is tested by reproducing results available in web/literature, testing against QuantLib's jump diffusion engine and comparison with Black pricing.
